Patch 1.13 Is live!

Small patch of QOL settings to make your Planet Popping smoother than ever

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44759748/4fdac859cd998ffd40ee6316d874ffeb55500067.png

Changes:
- Updated settings menu layout
- Settings Menu now include options for Resolution and Windowed mode
- Sound settings now use a slider so you can customize your audio experience
- Setting menu points now updates properly
- Settings will save and load properly so you don't need to reapply settings
- Cleaned up the planet dropper so planets can touch the left/right wall before dropping them

Enjoy!
